Nora Patel (AE): AlderBank kickoff reminder 1:00 PT tomorrow. They want OrbitAPI parity for chat + functions. Main asks: identical streaming events, header compatibility (x-orbit-session-id), and a straightforward price delta. Need owners.
Ethan Brooks (Solutions): For a minimal client impact approach I recommend a compatibility proxy that rewrites headers and streams Orbit-style deltas. Will that satisfy legal and security?
Samira Gomez (Eng): Yes, proxy is simplest. We'll emit `event: delta` frames and a final `event: done`. Need to confirm their expected chunk format. Orbit sends JSON chunks like `{\"delta\":{\"content\":\"...\"}}`.
Nora Patel (AE): AlderBank provided a sample earlier: `curl -X POST https://api.orbitai.com/v1/chat/generate -d '{"messages":...,"stream":true}'` and they emphasize stop tokens like `"\n\n"`. They also want rate-limit parity.
Ethan Brooks (Solutions): I'll draft the stream parity test cases (token order, function_call fragments, stop token handling, reconnect semantics).
Samira Gomez (Eng): Action items:
- samira: build docker proxy shim to accept Orbit headers, rewrite to /v1/chat, toggle `compat_mode=true`
- ethan: stream parity tests + sample curl clients
- riley: security questionnaire (data retention, PII redaction, KMS)
- diego: pricing delta doc comparing Orbit flat-call fee -> Redwood per-token. Use baseline 500k tokens/mo.
- nora: coordinate SSO, IP allowlist and customer kick-off cadence
Can we have a PoC image for internal smoke by end of day?
Diego Ramos (Sales Ops): For pricing: Orbit charges $0.05 per call + egress. We'll show our numbers as $/1k tokens and also compute an equivalent per-call price based on their median call token length. Draft by 4pm PT.
Riley Hart (Security): For EU data residency, confirm we run the proxy in eu-central and that logs are redacted. Also will need to confirm we do not store original Orbit API keys.
Samira Gomez (Eng): We'll ensure no raw keys are logged and session IDs are stored, with user PII redacted. Proxy will strip `Authorization` header before logging.
Ethan Brooks (Solutions): Function-calling parity: rename `tool_call` to `function_call` in stream if `compat_mode`. Also ensure function payload fragmentation order remains stable.
Samira Gomez (Eng): Rate-limit mapping plan snippet:
```
# map orbit retry-after to our X-RateInfo
if orbit_resp.status == 429:
  return 429, { 'X-RateInfo': orbit_resp.headers.get('Retry-After', 'unknown') }
```
Nora Patel (AE): Please also include a short runbook if parity fails during POC (canary rollback to our standard stream). They want clear escalation steps.
deploy-bot: Build queued: compatibility-proxy-poc image -> eu-central, ETA 2 hours
Ethan Brooks (Solutions): I'll post the smoke test links and the approval URL when ready.
Samira Gomez (Eng): Kicking off build now. Will update with image tag.
Riley Hart (Security): Starting questionnaire. Will request customer sample payloads for privacy review.
Diego Ramos (Sales Ops): Pricing draft will include a 30-day POC offer and a one-time migration credit if they commit to Dedicated within 60 days.
Nora Patel (AE): Thanks team. Quick status updates in this thread by 5pm PT please. :thumbsup:
